# Generated files

- Everything under `.github` is generated by `velnor-workflow` (the workflow
  generator in `tailrocks/velnor`, crate `crates/velnor-workflow`). Never
  hand-edit files in this directory: change the generator or this repository's
  generation configuration and regenerate. AGENTS.md files are the only
  hand-maintained files under `.github`.
- Do not reference or use the `velnor-actions` repository.
